selection: For each outer source, rank all candidates by inner whole-source MAE, tie RMSE then ID. Also retain separately selected per-family models. All numerical fixed-candidate outer scores are exploratory diagnostics, never a posthoc primary replacement.
pair_cache: Train a candidate once excluding source pair{i,j}; predictions for j can be inner validation for outer i, and vice versa. Neither excluded source enters preprocessing/fitting. Only j labels enter outer-i inner selection. Outer final predictions come from separate fits excluding i only.
features: Raw approved6 early summaries; optional approved static6/7; continuation view uses only algebraic functions of approved six. No new measured descriptor or later cycle information.
targets: delta=Rfinal-Rearly; log_ratio=log(Rfinal/Rearly); test target values never used. A uses Rfinal or log(Rfinal). Train-only source-weighted target scaling.
ensemble: Prespecified RF/GPR/XGB-early and RF-static branches; equal mean and nonnegative unit-sum inner-OOF least-squares weights with fixed1.0 L2 penalty to equal weights, no outer labels.
generalization: At least10 development source families and genuinely new untouched external-source validation; reuse of these development sources alone never achieves reliable-model acceptance.
early2E10: Previous4-source results retained as history, not newly optimized because two-level training would have only2 source families.
stop: Exactly6324 base estimator fits plus20 inner ensemble-weight fits. No in-run new candidates or scope. Next research phase remains active irrespective of this phase completion.
